__introCard.headline: Paid for the team yourself?
__introCard.sub: Add what you paid with a photo of the receipt. It counts as your contribution, and nobody has to pay you back.

__outroCard.sub: Works with or without a Bunq account for the team.

__intro: Paid for the team yourself? Put it in the pot.
Bought the team drinks with your own money? Open Money.
Tap, | Add an expense you paid.
Start with a photo of the receipt.
The app reads the total for you, | right on your phone.
Say what it was for, | and save.
There it is. One row: what it was, | and that you paid.
It counts as spent, and as your contribu: It counts as money spent, | and as your contribution.
So the balance stays the same, | and nobody has to pay you back.
Made a mistake? Just open it again.
No Bunq account for the team? It still w: If your team has no Bunq account, | it still works.
__outro: Try it today! Open Money, add what you paid, and snap the receipt. See you at TeamBalance dot N L!
